evidence.observation: Pressure gauge and exhaust oxygen sensor are not installed; pressure and oxygen remain unobserved through growth.

Growth temperature is 749.6 °C against 750 °C setpoint, Ar is 100.2 sccm against 100 sccm, heater power is 45.4%, and status is running; measured channels show stable operation but cannot establish the required tube atmosphere.
Temperature briefly reached 760.6 °C at growth entry, then returned near setpoint by 2760 s; no tolerance is provided to classify the transient as a fault.

args.missing_evidence: Independent tube-pressure and exhaust-oxygen measurements are needed to verify growth atmosphere and purge effectiveness; sample characterization is needed to assess target growth.
